summary: Verify a container group by creating a mock inventory using it, adding localhost with ansible_host 127.0.0.1 and ansible_connection local, and running an ad hoc ping or setup job; pods appear and disappear in the namespace.
questions: How do I test a container group works?
Verify a container group with an ad hoc command
How do I watch container group pods being created?

answer_card.title: Test a container group
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Create an inventory and set the container group in its *Instance groups* field.
2. Add host `localhost` with variables:
   ```
   {'ansible_host': '127.0.0.1', 'ansible_connection': 'local'}
   ```
3. Run an ad hoc job with the `ping` or `setup` module (any machine credential works).
4. Watch pods come and go with `oc get pod -n <namespace> -w`.
